title: Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages in the MME

entities.name: Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages
entities.description: Procedure for handling NAS signalling messages based on their integrity protection status in the MME. Defines which messages can be processed without protection and actions when integrity checks fail.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: NAS message used to provide identity information. Can be processed without integrity protection when requested parameter is IMSI.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: NAS message that rejects security mode establishment. Can be processed without integrity protection.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for tracking area update procedure. Can be sent without integrity protection in certain scenarios.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for detach procedure. Can be sent without integrity protection in emergency scenarios.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for attach procedure. Requires authentication if received without integrity protection for non-emergency services.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for service request procedure. Integrity check failure leads to service rejection for non-emergency services.

entities.name: HASHMME IE
entities.description: Information element included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND message when security mode control procedure is initiated after integrity check failure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with the network. MME may remain in this state if detach request fails integrity check.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is not registered with the network. Network uses additional criteria before marking UE in this state.

entities.name: Secure exchange of NAS messages established
entities.description: Condition indicating that secure NAS message exchange has been established. After this point, all messages must pass integrity check.

entities.name: Discard message
entities.description: Property where NAS in MME discards messages that fail integrity check after secure exchange is established.

relations.description: IDENTITY RESPONSE message can be processed without integrity protection when requested parameter is IMSI.
SECURITY MODE REJECT message can be processed without integrity protection.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message can be sent without integrity protection in certain scenarios.
DETACH REQUEST message can be sent without integrity protection for emergency services.
ATTACH REQUEST without integrity protection triggers security mode control with HASHMME IE.
If detach request fails integrity check and is due to switch off, MME may remain in EMM-REGISTERED state.
Once secure exchange is established, messages failing integrity check are discarded.
SERVICE REQUEST with integrity check failure for non-emergency services leads to service rejection while maintaining EMM context.
